authorization.delegation: Public source study snapshot; historical authorization omitted.

limitations: Original matcher/controller gates and 0.35m P95 rejection threshold unchanged.
Only the original checked worker job owns source pins; no shadow matcher or cache replacement.
PRE and POST are original checked jobs, not automatically accepted control; terminal-before-POST remains incomplete.
Registered full payload is /demo/slam/raw_registered_full; canonical bundle is metadata, not a second full registered cloud.
Complete received ROS message reserialization, not original wire CDR; whole group rejected if over cap.
No GTpose/IMU world quaternion/frontend z prior; no fabricated point timing.
Only actual source bracketing auxiliary messages retained; full LIO IMU consumption is not claimed; require_complete_imu=false.
R6 formal eight-group contract remains separate and unchanged.
No online shadow scoring; fixed16MiB logical and allocated capture cap.
Only the first two consecutive distinct original checked jobs with sole ray_p95 rejection in the same exact active request and parent generation arm capture.
Active requests are exploring/exploration, returning/return_origin, navigating/navigation_f1_f3; wrong run, idle or terminal request cannot arm.
PRE is the last checked job before the rejection streak; FAIL is the second rejection; POST is the next checked same-scope job; no frame is automatically control-accepted.
Duplicate P95 stamps do not count; non-P95 results, out-of-order source, association rejection, scope or generation changes break the streak; complete or expired capture never requests route stop.
Exactly one newly authorized C44 original-route diagnostic round; original C43 failed once-run and all prior seals/latches are preserved; no route or capture PASS is granted by approval.
